articles.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
articles.summary: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV returns to Peru to a big welcome, calls it his 'homeland'
articles.summary: An estimated 3 million people greeted Pope Leo XIV in Lima as the Peruvian-citizen pontiff began a six-day homecoming visit to the country where he spent two decades as a missionary and bishop.

articles.title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
articles.summary: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

articles.title: Famed ship SS United States deliberately sunk off Florida coast to become a reef
articles.summary: Activists wanted the historic liner to be turned into a museum, but it will instead become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

articles.title: Who could replace Jensen Huang? A highly unscientific list of possible successors
articles.summary: Nvidia has no succession plan and a CEO in hot water, so we’ve drafted a shortlist.
